demo.wording: This quote is valid until the date shown. After that date prices and availability may change.
Supplier prices can change before full payment. We tell you at once and you may accept or cancel.
The deposit secures the price and the booking. It is due on the date shown on your booking confirmation.
The balance due before travel must reach us by the final payment date. A late payment can cancel the booking.
Cancellation charges depend on the supplier terms. We show them before you pay. Our service fee is not refunded.
You are responsible for valid travel documents. Check the destination current rules before you book and before you travel.
We advise travel insurance for every traveller. If you decline it, we note your choice in writing.
A change may carry a supplier charge and our change fee. We quote both before we act.
Our service fee covers planning and booking work. It is shown as its own line and is before any tax.
Names must match the travel documents. A correction after booking can cost money.
A group has a rooming list deadline. Rooms not named by then may be released or charged.
Cruise deposits and final payments follow the cruise terms. The final payment date is the strictest one.

guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: mark-up, planning fee, smallest fee, target margin, reply hours, days a quote stays valid and the budget that needs the owner.
Check Team, Clients, Trips and Suppliers. They hold the people, clients, trips and suppliers that every other sheet looks up.
Fill Service Fee Schedule with your own services and fees, and mark the ones you waive for repeat clients.
Fill Destination Price Guide with hotel, daily spend and air fare for the places you sell most, in peak and low season.
Log each enquiry on Enquiries, each first call on Discovery Calls and each brief on Trip Briefs. Replies, follow-ups and budget per person are checked for you.
Write each quote on Quotes and its components on Quote Lines. Margin, margin on net, expiry and chase checks fill in.
Keep Trip Packages and Quote Terms Library as your standard offers and standard clauses.
Record every touch on Follow-up Log and every lost enquiry on Lost Enquiries so the reasons teach you something.
Track Marketing Results and Referral Partners to see which source and which partner bring trips that pay.
Watch Advisor Capacity Weeks before you promise a quote date, and Seasonal Demand and Pipeline by Month for the yearly picture.
Use the 14 calculators for quotes, margins, fees, budgets, payment plans, win chance, counter-offers, add-ons, expiry dates and what-ifs.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Sales Dashboard and Charts every week: enquiries, quotes, bookings, sources, lost reasons, margin and free hours.

listing.title: Travel Agent Enquiries, Quotes and Trip Pricing Excel Template: Quote Builder, Margin Check, Service Fees, Pipeline, Capacity
listing.headline: Turn enquiries into booked trips at a margin that pays
listing.description:
Run the sales side of an independent travel agent or travel advisor business in one Excel workbook. Enquiries logs every contact with its source, budget and travellers, and tells you whether you replied in time, which follow-up is overdue and whether a quote went out on time. Quotes holds each trip quote with the supplier net price (the price the supplier charges before commission), your service fee and the expected commission (the share of the price a supplier pays you after travel), and Quote Lines splits it by supplier so you see the mark-up and margin of every component.

The Trip Quote Builder turns supplier net prices into a client price, a service fee, your commission and the shares of the host agency (the larger agency whose booking access and supplier deals you use, for a share of each commission) and of the advisor. The Quote Margin Check shows the lowest fee or price that reaches your target before you send. The Deposit and Final Payment Plan gives every date and amount of the deposit and of the final payment (the balance due before travel), and the Budget Reality Check shows what a client budget can buy at a destination.

Discovery Calls, Trip Briefs, Follow-up Log, Lost Enquiries, Trip Packages, Destination Price Guide, Service Fee Schedule, Quote Terms Library, Referral Partners, Marketing Results, Advisor Capacity Weeks, Seasonal Demand and Pipeline by Month cover the rest of the sales year: days from enquiry to quote, why you lose trips, which source costs least per booking, which partner sends paying clients and whether the team has free hours for a new trip.

14 calculators cover quotes, margins, service fees, budgets, per-person prices, payment plans, win chance, counter-offers, two-option comparisons, source cost, capacity, add-ons, expiry dates and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part one of the Travel Agent suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small advisor business to explore first. It helps you plan your sales and does not promise results.

messages.text: Hello {contact}, your discovery call with {advisor} is confirmed for {date}, about {minutes} minutes. Please tell us if the time changes.

messages.moment: Client: send your dates and names
messages.text: Hello {contact}, to plan your trip please send your travel dates and the names of all {travellers} travellers as they appear on their travel documents.

messages.moment: Client: your trip brief is ready
messages.text: Hello {contact}, your trip brief is ready: {travellers} travellers, {nights} nights, a budget of {budget}. Please check it and tell us what to change.

messages.moment: Client: your quote is ready
messages.text: Hello {client}, your quote for {destination} is ready: {total_quote} for {travellers} travellers. Shall we go through it together?

messages.moment: Client: your quote is valid until
messages.text: Hello {client}, your quote for {destination} is valid until {valid_until}. After that date prices may change. Please tell us if you need more time.

messages.moment: Client: a gentle quote reminder
messages.text: Hello {client}, a gentle reminder about your {destination} quote sent on {date_sent}. Do you have questions, or would a call help?

messages.moment: Client: three options for your budget
messages.text: Hello {contact}, for your budget of {budget} we can offer three options: about {opt_low}, {budget} or {opt_high} for the whole trip. Which feels closest?

messages.moment: Client: the price explained line by line
messages.text: Hello {client}, I will send your {destination} quote line by line. The total is {total_quote}, which is {per_person} per person. Our service fee of {service_fee} is its own line.

messages.moment: Client: your deposit secures the price
messages.text: Hello {client}, your deposit secures the price of your {destination} trip. It is due on {deposit_due}. Please tell us when it is sent.

messages.moment: Client: your deposit has arrived
messages.text: Hello {client}, your deposit arrived on {deposit_paid_on}. Thank you. Your {destination} trip is secured.

messages.moment: Client: next steps after booking
messages.text: Hello {client}, thank you for booking {destination}. Next we will send your payment dates, a travel document check and your itinerary. Your trip number is {trip_id}.

messages.moment: Client: prices may change after expiry
messages.text: Hello {client}, prices for {destination} may change after {valid_until}. Please tell us by then if you want to book at {total_quote}.

messages.moment: Client: sorry about your budget
messages.text: Hello {contact}, thank you for considering us. We are sorry we could not match your budget for your {trip_type} trip. We would be glad to help in the future.

messages.moment: Client: thank you for the referral
messages.text: Hello {name}, thank you for recommending us to a friend. It means a great deal to the whole team.

messages.moment: Client: your quote change is attached
messages.text: Hello {client}, your quote change is attached. The total is now {total_quote} and it is valid until {valid_until}. Please check it and tell us.

messages.moment: Client: a question about your dates
messages.text: Hello {contact}, a quick question about your dates: can you travel any time between {window_start} and {window_end}?

messages.moment: Partner: we booked a trip you sent
messages.text: Hello {contact}, we booked a trip you sent, thank you. You have sent {leads} enquiries and {bookings} became trips so far. A thank-you is on its way.

messages.moment: Partner: a new enquiry that may suit you
messages.text: Hello {contact}, we have a new enquiry that may suit you or your clients. Please call us if you would like to hear more.

messages.moment: Owner: a quote expires soon
messages.text: Hello, the quote for {client} expires on {valid_until}. Total {total_quote}. Chase check: {chase_flag}. Please decide whether to ask for an extension.

messages.moment: Owner: enquiry above the usual budget
messages.text: Hello, the enquiry from {contact} is above the usual budget: {budget} for {travellers} travellers ({trip_type}, {destination}). Please join the first call.

messages.moment: Owner: a quote needs your approval
messages.text: Hello, the quote for {client} needs your approval: total {total_quote}, margin {margin}. Margin check: {margin_flag}.

messages.moment: Owner: the weekly sales summary is ready
messages.text: Hello, the sales summary is ready. In {month}: {enquiries} enquiries, {quotes} quotes, {won} won, sales won {sales_won}.

messages.moment: Owner: the margin is below the target
messages.text: Hello, the margin on the {destination} quote for {client} is {margin_net} of the net price, below the target. Total {total_quote}. Please review the fee.

messages.moment: Advisor: new enquiry assigned to you
messages.text: Hello, a new enquiry is assigned to you: {contact}, {trip_type}, {destination}, budget {budget}, {travellers} travellers. Please reply within a day.

messages.moment: Advisor: trip booked, start the handover
messages.text: Hello, trip {trip_id} for {client} to {destination} is booked. Please start the handover and check the deposit date, {deposit_due}.

messages.moment: Advisor: your capacity is full
messages.text: Hello {advisor}, your capacity is full in the week of {week}: {free_hours} free hours. Please do not take new trips in that week without asking the owner.

messages.moment: Freelance: availability for an itinerary
messages.text: Hello {name}, are you available to draw up an itinerary for a new trip? Please tell us your rate and the days you can offer.

documents.title: Trip proposal and price summary
paragraphs: Trip proposal of {set:company}, dated {today}. Quote {col:quotes.quote_id}.

Dear {col:quotes.client}, thank you for the chance to plan your {col:quotes.trip_type} trip to {col:quotes.destination} for {col:quotes.travellers} travellers. This page sets out our proposal and the price.

Total price: {col:quotes.total_quote}, which is {col:quotes.per_person} per person. Our service fee of {col:quotes.service_fee} is included and shown as its own line. Prices are before any tax. The components of the trip add up to {col:quotes.lines_total}.
This proposal is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}. After that date prices and availability may change. To accept it, sign below and pay the deposit we confirm with you.
Your advisor is {col:quotes.advisor}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Quote comparison for a client
paragraphs: Quote comparison of {set:company} for {col:enquiries.contact}, dated {today}. Enquiry {col:enquiries.enquiry_id}: {col:enquiries.trip_type} to {col:enquiries.destination}, {col:enquiries.travellers} travellers.
Your budget: {col:enquiries.budget}, which is {col:enquiries.budget_pp} per person. Our quote: {col:enquiries.quote_total}. The quote less your budget: {col:enquiries.quote_gap}.
If the quote is above your budget we can shorten the trip, choose a lower hotel tier or move to cheaper dates. Tell us which matters most and we will price it.
Budget size check: {col:enquiries.size_flag}. Follow-up date: {col:enquiries.follow_up_date}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Three package options for a budget
paragraphs: Three options of {set:company} for {col:enquiries.contact}, dated {today}. Trip: {col:enquiries.trip_type} to {col:enquiries.destination} for {col:enquiries.travellers} travellers. Your budget: {col:enquiries.budget}.
Lower option: a total of about {col:enquiries.opt_low}. Simpler hotels or a shorter stay, the same destination.
Middle option: a total of about {col:enquiries.budget}. Our best match for what you told us.
Higher option: a total of about {col:enquiries.opt_high}. Better rooms, more included and more private services.
Each option is a starting point. We can mix them. Reply with the one that feels closest and we will build a full quote.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Discovery call summary
paragraphs: Discovery call summary of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Call on {col:discovery.date}: {col:discovery.minutes} minutes with {col:discovery.advisor}. Contact: {col:discovery.contact}. Trip type: {col:discovery.trip_type}.
Outcome: {col:discovery.outcome}. Next step on {col:discovery.next_step_date}. Next step check: {col:discovery.step_flag}.
Days from the call to the quote: {col:discovery.days_to_quote}.
Notes of the call, the places the contact likes and the questions they raised are written below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Trip brief summary for approval
paragraphs: Trip brief summary of {set:company} for {col:briefs.contact}, dated {today}. Brief {col:briefs.brief_id}.
{col:briefs.travellers} travellers, {col:briefs.nights} nights, travelling between {col:briefs.window_start} and {col:briefs.window_end} ({col:briefs.window_days} days of choice).
Budget: {col:briefs.budget}, which is {col:briefs.budget_pppn} per person per night. Pace: {col:briefs.pace}.
Must-haves: {col:briefs.must_haves}. Please avoid: {col:briefs.avoid}.
Please check every line. Your signature approves the brief as the basis of the quote.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Quote terms and conditions
paragraphs: Terms of {set:company} for quote {col:quotes.quote_id}, dated {today}. Client: {col:quotes.client}.
Validity: this quote is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}. After that date prices and availability may change.
Price changes: supplier prices can change before full payment. We tell you at once and you may accept the change or cancel.

Payments: the deposit secures the price. The balance due before travel must reach us by the final payment date on your booking confirmation. Our service fee of {col:quotes.service_fee} is shown as its own line and is not refunded if you cancel.
Travel documents: you are responsible for valid travel documents. Check the destination current rules before you book and before you travel. We advise travel insurance for every traveller.
Your signature accepts these terms for this quote.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Quote expiry reminder letter
paragraphs: Reminder of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:quotes.client}, our quote {col:quotes.quote_id} for your trip to {col:quotes.destination} is valid until {col:quotes.valid_until}, which is {col:quotes.days_to_expiry} days from today.
The total is {col:quotes.total_quote} for {col:quotes.travellers} travellers. After the expiry date the price and the availability may change.
If you have questions or want changes, please tell us. We can ask the suppliers to extend the price once if you need more time.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Referral partner thank-you note
paragraphs: Thank-you note of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:partners.contact}, thank you for the clients you send us. So far you have sent {col:partners.leads} enquiries and {col:partners.bookings} became trips, with a value of {col:partners.value}.
Your last thank-you from us was on {col:partners.thank_you_date}. We report back on every trip you send and we are glad to help your own clients and customers.
We would be glad to meet and share ideas for the coming season.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Service fee agreement for a trip
paragraphs: Service fee agreement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Quote {col:quotes.quote_id}, client {col:quotes.client}.
Our service fee for planning and booking your {col:quotes.trip_type} trip to {col:quotes.destination} is {col:quotes.service_fee}, before any tax.
The fee covers planning, quotes, booking, document checks and support until you travel. Suppliers may also pay us a commission. That commission does not change the price you pay.
A change after booking can carry a change fee. We quote it before we act. The service fee is not refunded if you cancel.
Your signature accepts the fee.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Sales pipeline report for one month
paragraphs: Sales pipeline report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Month: {col:pipeline.month}.
Enquiries received: {col:pipeline.enquiries}. Quotes sent: {col:pipeline.quotes}. Quotes won: {col:pipeline.won}. Quotes lost: {col:pipeline.lost}.
Sales won: {col:pipeline.sales_won}. Win rate of decided quotes: {col:pipeline.win_rate}.
Actions for next month and the person who owns each one are written below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.
